familyCreator.title: Family Creator
familyCreator.intro: Choose a PDF, picture or text file, paste text, or type the overall size. Free, runs in your browser. Pictures and scanned PDFs are read on this device (OCR, English), so check the numbers it finds. The parts come from a ready-made shape for your product, not from tracing the drawing.
familyCreator.name: Product name
familyCreator.textPlaceholder: Paste text, e.g. Overall size: 1200 x 700 x 2000 mm
familyCreator.sizeHint: Or enter the size in mm (width, depth, height). A typed size wins over pasted text.

detail.noSize: No clear overall size (width x depth x height) found in the text. Enter the size yourself in the boxes above.

warn.title: Not used from the sheet
warn.notUsed: {label} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) is not a setting of the {shape} shape, so it was not used.
warn.outOfRange: {label} {value} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) is outside what this shape allows, so the default is used instead.
warn.conflict: {label} appears with different values (page {page}, line {line} and {other}), so none was used and the default is kept. Check the sheet and enter the value yourself.
warn.ambiguous: {label} (page {page}, line {line}: {text}) could include or exclude the top and bottom shelves, so it was not used. Set Middle shelves yourself.
